name: scale
note: Scaled testbed (H12 draft): the 63-agent random workflows on S agentd sites (configs/lab-scale.json; S is the workload's placement). Base: the comparison at S = 32 on rand-n63-s0-S32 (Firebreak, Trace & quarantine, Stop team, No containment x early/late x 3 repetitions, plus the no-fault reference). Parts: the rogue instance (rand-n63-s0-S32 at rogue rate 0.3, the same strategies, 2 repetitions) and the scale curve (rand-n63-s0 at S = 3, 8, 16: the reference and Firebreak early/late x 3 repetitions; its S = 32 point is the base's). 72 runs, about 5.7 h. A second instance's S = 32 comparison is in scale-extra.json.
